interface.shortDescription: Superpowers for AI game dev. Build games by talking.
interface.longDescription: Summer turns Codex into a game-dev studio for Summer Engine — the AI-native game engine. 24 auto-trigger skills covering brainstorm, design, build, play, debug, ship — plus a using-summer meta-skill that establishes workflow priority on session start. The MCP bridge talks to the local Summer Engine for scene mutation, asset import, render, play, and diagnostics — 37 focused tools across scene/debug/project/asset/generate, with file/git/shell/grep deferred to the host agent. Summer Engine is compatible with Godot 4.5 — write code in GDScript, drive the engine via MCP. Session-start orients the session. Pre-commit doctor (opt-in) blocks bad commits.
defaultPrompt: I want to make a game.
